candidate.name: Gepard 1.0
candidate.artifact_shape_observed: safetensors model; Hugging Face tree approximately 1.13 GB total at observation time

primary_source_observations: The exact observed model-card revision declares only en, es, pt, nl in language metadata; German/de is absent.
The current model page likewise lists English, Spanish (Mexico), Portuguese (Brazil), and Dutch (Netherlands) as supported languages.
Upstream describes Gepard as decoder-only autoregressive streaming TTS with a Qwen-family backbone and NVIDIA NeMo NanoCodec, with zero-shot voice cloning and a vLLM serving path.
The vLLM serving project exposes cancellable streaming/barge-in semantics; it also documents sentence-level streaming where prosody resets at sentence boundaries.
Upstream latency/throughput figures are hardware-specific upstream claims and grant zero Frankenstein runtime credit.

result.falsifier_boundary: This result proves only that German is not declared by the pinned upstream source. It does not prove the model is physically incapable of emitting German. Under Trigger-7's German-first production law, unsupported German is sufficient to deny production-candidate credit at this source scope.

next_action: Retain Gepard as an architecture/reference donor for low-latency vLLM-native TTS, cancellation and serving design. Do not spend clay-direct-dev runtime headroom on it while German-capable Qwen3-TTS, MagpieTTS, Supertonic/CosyVoice-family or other admitted candidates remain unresolved. Reopen only if upstream adds explicit German support or owner language priority changes.
